decisions.decision: Minutes of March 18, 2019 recorded as approved (no motion or tally printed).
Extensions for the expired septic permits at 211/219 W. Townsend Road would not be given, because work has not begun.
decisions.quote: because work has not begun, extensions would not be given.

decisions.decision: At 113 Sandy Cove Road the well may remain as an agricultural well if disconnected from the residence (proof to the board) and a deed restriction notification is placed on the property.
decisions.quote: the well can remain provided it be disconnected from the residence

decisions.decision: Anyone applying for an Event Permit must meet all Board of Health Regulations and provide their proposal directly to the Board of Health.

decisions.decision: The system at 25 Pearl Street is in failure and the matter will be marked up for hearing in Housing Court.
